title: encrypt.rs: ecdh_wrap_cek match arms duplicate AES-128/256-KW code
description: ecdh_wrap_cek() has two nearly identical match arms for kek_len 16 and 32, differing only in the concrete type (KwAes128 vs KwAes256). Since aes-kw types don't share a common trait accessible here, a clean deduplication requires a macro or internal helper. The current duplication is ~10 lines and low-risk to maintain, but future additions (e.g. AES-192) would require a third copy. Consider a small macro or closure pattern to reduce repetition.
